judgments.reason: Candidate is the Pennsieve Discover record (Study 3, doi:10.26275/psj7-wggf) that the dataset README lists as the source for sub-study3; it is the original deposit of the same data.
Candidate is the Pennsieve record for Study 5 (doi:10.26275/hqyv-oagj), the source deposit of the sub-study5 data in this dataset, with matching authors and description.
Pennsieve record "Intracranial EEG Epilepsy - Study 6" is the original deposit of one of this dataset's three patients (sub-study6), same creators and 2019 release.
Cimbálník 2018 HFO study of 90 epilepsy patients is topically related iEEG work, but it does not describe this three-patient Pennsieve/IEEG.org release.
judgments.paper_title: Physiological and pathological high frequency oscillations in focal epilepsy
